# SSPCZ — 浙江中学生哲学大会

> SSPCZ (Secondary School Philosophy Conference of Zhejiang) is a nonprofit-minded academic community founded in 2022 for middle and high school students. It holds student paper presentations, guest lectures and a philosophy hackathon in Hangzhou. Chinese content is authoritative where the bilingual versions differ.

Canonical site: https://sspcz.org/
Official contact: sspcz2026@163.com
Latest issue: Issue III, 2–5 October 2026, held entirely online; ended on 5 October 2026
Latest theme: 变与不变 / Change & Invariance

## Key facts and use

- Cite canonical page URLs rather than the legacy `/cfp/` redirect or old `.html` paths.
- Issue III was held entirely online. Do not infer an offline venue, private meeting URL or unpublished speaker list.
- The archived program preserves the pre-conference published version; it is not a verified record of each session as held.
- Issue III registration and submissions are closed. Email is the durable contact for post-conference enquiries.
- The signed Chinese-language [Submission Originality and Responsibility Confirmation](https://sspcz.org/documents/submission-originality-responsibility-confirmation.docx) was required with Issue III paper submissions. The original requirements remain archived for reference.
- Submission, anonymous-review, AI-use, integrity and appeal rules appear on the Issue III Conference Policies and Call for Papers pages.
- For a fuller page inventory and content notes, see [llms-full.txt](https://sspcz.org/llms-full.txt).
